method: Start from the sharpest available price with the vig removed, then adjust only for evidence that the market may not have priced. Sources listed per leg.

legs.label: NFL: Seahawks to win at Broncos
legs.why: Consensus books SEA -160 / DEN +135 -> 59.1% no-vig. No injury news found that the line hasn't absorbed.

legs.label: NFL: Seahawks -2.5 (win by 3+)
legs.why: Books SEA -3 (+100) / DEN +3 (-120) -> 47.8% to cover -3; ~9% of games land on exactly 3 -> ~52.5% to win by 3+.

legs.label: NFL: SEA-DEN over 40.5 points
legs.why: Books 40.5 at -110/-110 (50%). Total fell from 42.5 to 40.5 this week; Denver at altitude is a slower-paced matchup. Slight under lean.

legs.label: ATP Jinan: Keegan Smith to beat Landaluce
legs.why: Books (bet365) 1.43/2.72 -> Smith 34.5% no-vig; Polymarket has him at 25.5%. Landaluce #73 vs Smith #202, but Smith has won two three-setters here this week. Shaded toward the favorite because the book quote isn't sharp: 32%.

legs.label: ATP Shanghai QF: Casper Ruud to beat Jodar
legs.why: Books 1.80/2.02 -> Ruud 47.1%. Jodar 54-17 in 2026 and strongest on hard courts; Ruud's best surface is clay. 46%.
